title: Hypersurfaces with Non-diagonalizable Shape Operators in Minkowski Spaces
summary: In this paper, we study hypersurfaces $M^4$ in the Minkowski space $\mathbb{E}^5_1$ whose shape operator $S$ is non-diagonalizable, having a triple real eigenvalue $λ$ with a one-dimensional eigenspace together with a simple eigenvalue $μ$ (Case~(iii) in the classification of Magid). Assuming that $λ$ and $μ$ satisfy a functional relation $λ=f(μ)$ and that the eigenvector field of $μ$ is geodesic, we show that $λ$ and $μ$, as well as the pseudo-orthonormal frame, are intrinsic invariants of $M$, determined by the induced metric up to sign.
